tier_semantics.declared: descriptor_tiers v1: boolean anchor plus non-empty evidence string
tier_semantics.verified: bound facet receipts only, one rung at a time over declared facets

status_definition.not-declared: the descriptor does not claim the facet
status_definition.declared: claimed; the evidence field names nothing that can be located
status_definition.unavailable: claimed; at least one named file or test node does not exist
status_definition.located: every named file and test node exists; no receipt records a run
status_definition.bound: the newest receipt is creditable and every subject digest still matches
status_definition.stale: the newest receipt was creditable, but a subject changed or vanished
status_definition.invalid: the newest receipt cannot credit the facet
